# Generate TABLES for Experiment 2 


```{r}
library(data.table)   # fread(), rbindlist()

## 1. datasets you simulated
data_names <- c(
  "acic2018_1000", "acic2018_2500", "acic2018_5000", "acic2018_10000",
  "ihdp", "lalonde_cps", "lalonde_psid", "twins",
  sprintf("acic2017_%02d", 17:24)
)

## 2. we care only about “xgboost”
method  <- "xgboost"

## 3. directory holding the CSVs
root <- "~/repos/calibratedDML/paper_experiment_results"

## 4. read whichever files exist  -------------------------------------------
files <- file.path(root, sprintf("sim_results_%s_%s.csv", data_names, method))
names(files) <- data_names                      # keeps dataset names handy

sim_results <- lapply(files[file.exists(files)], fread, showProgress = FALSE)

## 5. (optional) single long table with dataset & method columns ------------
all_results <- rbindlist(
  lapply(names(sim_results), function(ds) {
    sim_results[[ds]][, `:=`(dataset = ds, method = method)]
  }),
  use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE
)

# 'sim_results' : list(dataset -> data.table)
# 'all_results' : tidy data.table for downstream analysis

all_results <- all_results[all_results$misp == 1]
 
library(data.table)

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 0.  Harmonise estimator labels (auDRI → C-DML)  --------------
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
all_results[estimator %in% c("auDRI", "au_dri", "auDRI_xgb"), estimator := "C-DML"]

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 1.  Metrics per dataset × estimator                           |
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
all_results[, `:=`(
  abs_bias = (estimate - ATE),
  sq_error = (estimate - ATE)^2,
  covered  = CI_left <= ATE & CI_right >= ATE
)]

summ <- all_results[
  , .(Bias = abs(mean(abs_bias))/mean(abs(ATE)),
      RMSE = sqrt(mean(sq_error))/mean(abs(ATE)),
      Coverage = mean(covered)),
  by = .(dataset, estimator)
]

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 2.  Long → apply bolding → wide                               |
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
long <- melt(summ,
             id.vars = c("dataset", "estimator"),
             variable.name = "metric")

## rank: smaller is better except Coverage (larger better)
long[, rank := {
  score <- if (metric == "Coverage") -value else value
  rank(score, ties.method = "min")
}, by = .(dataset, metric)]

## format + bold
long[, value_fmt := sprintf(ifelse(metric == "Coverage", "%.2f", "%.3f"), value)]
long[rank == 1,  value_fmt := paste0("\\textbf{", value_fmt, "}")]

wide_fmt <- dcast(long,
                  dataset ~ metric + estimator,
                  value.var = "value_fmt")

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 3.  Pretty dataset names                                      |
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
pretty_ds <- function(ds) {
  if      (grepl("^acic2017_", ds)) sprintf("ACIC-2017 (%s)", sub("acic2017_", "", ds))
  else if (grepl("^acic2018_", ds)) sprintf("ACIC-2018 (%s)", sub("acic2018_", "", ds))
  else if (ds == "ihdp")            "IHDP"
  else if (ds == "twins")           "Twins"
  else if (ds == "lalonde_cps")     "Lalonde CPS"
  else if (ds == "lalonde_psid")    "Lalonde PSID"
  else                              ds
}
wide_fmt[, Dataset := vapply(dataset, pretty_ds, character(1))]
setcolorder(wide_fmt, c("Dataset", setdiff(names(wide_fmt), c("Dataset", "dataset"))))
setorder(wide_fmt, Dataset)

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 4.  Build LaTeX table                                         |
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
make_latex <- function(dt) {
  # Escape underscores for LaTeX
  esc <- function(x) if (is.character(x)) gsub("_", "\\\\_", x, fixed = TRUE) else x

  # Remove \textbf{} and convert safely to numeric
  to_numeric <- function(x) as.numeric(gsub("^\\\\textbf\\{(.*)\\}$", "\\1", x))

  # Format each row with bolding and rounding
  format_row <- function(r) {
    r <- r[1:7]
    dataset <- esc(r[1])
    values <- r[2:7]

    # Convert to numeric after stripping bold
    numeric_vals <- sapply(values, to_numeric)

    # Round to 2 significant figures
    rounded_vals <- signif(numeric_vals, 2)

    # Apply bolding to better estimator in each pair (Bias, RMSE, Coverage)
    for (i in c(1, 3, 5)) {
      if (is.na(rounded_vals[i]) || is.na(rounded_vals[i + 1])) next
      if (rounded_vals[i] < rounded_vals[i + 1]) {
        rounded_vals[i] <- paste0("\\textbf{", rounded_vals[i], "}")
      } else if (rounded_vals[i + 1] < rounded_vals[i]) {
        rounded_vals[i + 1] <- paste0("\\textbf{", rounded_vals[i + 1], "}")
      }
    }

    paste("            ", paste(c(dataset, rounded_vals), collapse = " & "), "\\\\")
  }

  latex_rows <- apply(dt, 1, format_row)

  cat(paste(
"\\begin{figure}
\\begin{table}[H]
    \\centering
    \\caption{Evaluation of absolute bias, scaled root mean square error (RMSE), and 95\\% confidence-interval coverage. Both outcome regression and propensity scores are estimated with gradient-boosted trees.}
    \\begin{subtable}{\\textwidth}
        \\centering
        \\footnotesize
        \\begin{tabular}{|c||P{1.5cm}|P{1.5cm}||P{1.5cm}|P{1.5cm}||P{1.5cm}|P{1.5cm}|}
            \\hline
            \\multirow{2}{*}{\\textbf{Dataset}} &
              \\multicolumn{2}{c||}{\\textbf{Bias}} &
              \\multicolumn{2}{c||}{\\textbf{RMSE}} &
              \\multicolumn{2}{c|}{\\textbf{Coverage}} \\\\
            \\cline{2-7}
            & AIPW & C-DML & AIPW & C-DML & AIPW & C-DML \\\\
            \\hline\\hline",
    paste(latex_rows, collapse = "\n            \\hline\n"),
"            \\hline
        \\end{tabular}
    \\end{subtable}
    \\label{fig::exp2}
\\end{table}
\\end{figure}"
  , sep = "\n"))
}



# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 5.  Print LaTeX to console                                    |
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
make_latex(wide_fmt)
```

 
 
 
# Generate PLOTS for Experiment 1


```{r}
setwd("~/repos/calibratedDML")

library(data.table)

# Set working directory to the folder with the files
root <- "~/repos/calibratedDML/paper_experiment_results"

# List only the desired files (not containing 'pos=2')
files <- list.files(root, pattern = "^sim_results_DR_iter=5000_n=\\d+\\.csv$")

# Load and combine them with sample size extracted
sim_data <- rbindlist(lapply(files, function(f) {
  n_val <- as.integer(sub(".*n=(\\d+)\\.csv", "\\1", f))
  dt <- fread(file.path(root, f))
  dt[, n := n_val]
  return(dt)
}))

sim_data <- sim_data[sim_data$n >= 250]
 
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)

##### 1. Summarise the simulation results #####
sim_data[, covered := CI_left <= ATE & CI_right >= ATE]

summary_stats <- sim_data[, .(
  Bias     = abs(mean(estimate - ATE)),
  SE       = sd(estimate),
  Coverage = mean(covered)
), by = .(n, estimator, misp)]

##### 2. Define which x-axis ticks to label #####
n_tick_labels <- c(250, 2500, 5000, 7500)  # Only label these, but use all data

##### 3. Aesthetic mappings #####
summary_stats[, Estimator := factor(
  estimator,
  levels  = c("AIPW", "drtmle", "auDRI"),
  labels  = c("AIPW", "DR–TMLE", "IC–DML")
)]

est_colors <- c(
  "AIPW"     = "#E57373",  # muted red
  "DR–TMLE"  = "#81C784",  # muted green
  "IC–DML"   = "#64B5F6"   # muted blue
)

est_shapes <- c("AIPW" = 16,          "DR–TMLE" = 17,            "IC–DML" = 15)

##### 4. Plot helper #####
make_plot <- function(d, yvar, ylab, hline = FALSE, legend = FALSE, ylim = NULL) {
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = n, y = get(yvar),
                     group = Estimator, color = Estimator, shape = Estimator)) +
    geom_line(aes(group = Estimator),
              color = "grey60", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_point(size = 2.8, stroke = 0.3) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = n_tick_labels, labels = n_tick_labels) +
    scale_color_manual(name = "Estimator", values = est_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_shape_manual(name = "Estimator", values = est_shapes, drop = FALSE) +
    guides(
      color = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE),
      shape = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE)
    ) +
    labs(x = "Sample Size (n)", y = ylab) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position  = if (legend) "bottom" else "none",
      legend.box       = "horizontal",
      legend.margin    = margin(t = 0, b = 4),
      legend.text      = element_text(margin = margin(r = 10, unit = "pt")),
      legend.title     = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y     = element_text(margin = margin(r = 5)),
      axis.title.x     = element_text(margin = margin(t = 5)),
      plot.margin      = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)  # removes outer whitespace
    )

  if (!is.null(ylim)) {
    p <- p + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, ylim))
  }
  if (hline) {
    p <- p + geom_hline(yintercept = 0.95, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40")
  }

  return(p)
}





 # Compute per-misp y-axis limits for Bias and SE
ylim_lookup <- summary_stats[
  , .(ylim_bias_se = max(c(Bias, SE))), 
  by = misp
]


##### 5. Generate plots for each misp #####
base_height   <- 3.8
legend_height <- 0.12  # proportion for legend (or empty spacer)

for (m in sort(unique(summary_stats$misp))) {
  d <- summary_stats[misp == m]
  d[, Estimator := factor(Estimator, levels = levels(summary_stats$Estimator))]

  shared_ylim <- ylim_lookup[misp == m, ylim_bias_se]

  show_legend <- FALSE

  p_bias <- make_plot(d, "Bias", "Bias", legend = FALSE, ylim = shared_ylim)
  p_se   <- make_plot(d, "SE",   "Standard Error", legend = FALSE, ylim = shared_ylim)
  p_cov  <- make_plot(d, "Coverage", "Coverage", hline = TRUE, legend = FALSE)

  row_plot <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  p_bias, p_se, p_cov,
  nrow = 1, align = "hv", axis = "tblr"
)


   if (show_legend) {
    legend_plot <- make_plot(d, "Coverage", "Coverage", hline = TRUE, legend = TRUE)
    legend <- cowplot::get_legend(legend_plot)
    second_row <- legend
    rel_heights <- c(1 - legend_height, legend_height)
  } else {
    second_row <- NULL
    rel_heights <- c(1, 0)  # No space for spacer
  }

  final <- cowplot::plot_grid(
    row_plot,
    second_row,
    ncol = 1,
    rel_heights = rel_heights
  )

 
ggsave(sprintf("paper_experiment_results/simulation_misp%d.pdf", m),
       final, width = 10.5, height = base_height, device = cairo_pdf)

}
```

```{r}
##### 6. Stand-alone legend (ggplot-only) #####
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)

est_colors <- c(
  "AIPW"     = "#E57373",  # muted red
  "DR–TMLE"  = "#81C784",  # muted green
    "Calibrated DML (ours)"   = "#64B5F6"   # muted blue
)

 

est_shapes <- c(
  "AIPW"           = 16,
  "DR–TMLE"    = 17,
     "Calibrated DML (ours)"        = 15
)

# -- 6b. Dummy data: one row per Estimator level --------------------
legend_dt <- data.table(
  Estimator = factor(
    names(est_colors),
    levels = names(est_colors)
  ),
  n     = 1,
  value = 1
)

# -- 6c. Build plot: empty panel + legend ---------------------------
legend_plot <- ggplot(legend_dt,
                      aes(x = n, y = value,
                          colour = Estimator, shape = Estimator)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = est_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = est_shapes, drop = FALSE) +
  guides(
    colour = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE),
    shape  = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE)
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box      = "horizontal",
    legend.title    = element_blank(),
    plot.margin     = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )

# -- 6d. Save legend-only plot --------------------------------------
ggsave("paper_experiment_results/legend_only.pdf", legend_plot, width = 6, height = 0.9)
```

```{r}
library(data.table)

n_list <- c(  500, 1000, 2000, 3000  )
pos_list <- c(1,2,3 )

results <-
  rbindlist(unlist(lapply(n_list, function(n){
    unlist(lapply(pos_list, function(pos) {
  lapply(c(0), function(misp) {
    try({
      
    key <- paste0("DR_iter=", "500", "_n=", n, "_pos=", pos )
   data <- fread(paste0("../simResultsDR/sim_results_", key, ".csv"))
   
   return(data)
    })
    return(data.table())
  })
}), recursive = F)
}), recursive = F))

 
results[, coverage := CI_left <= ATE & CI_right >= ATE]
results[, sd := abs(CI_left -CI_right)/1.96/2]

results[, rmse := sqrt(bias^2 + se^2)]

w <- 5
h <- 4
for(pos_const in unique(results$pos_const)) {
```
